about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm a self-taught and passionate programmer with 2 years dedicated to application development and contributing to open-source projects.
about.p2: Effective autodidact with a strong command of React.js, Tailwind CSS, and Node.js, and a proven ability to manage projects from conception to deployment. Eager to contribute my motivation and technical skills to a dynamic team.

contributions_descriptions.0: Contributed 16 merged pull requests, making consistent additions to the codebase.
contributions_descriptions.1: Frontend Feature Development: Implemented the Workout section by integrating video components to display each participant's training routines, enriching the platform's content.
contributions_descriptions.2: UX Optimization: Enhanced the interface by integrating smooth animations into the BoxerGallery, significantly improving user interaction and experience.
contributions_descriptions.3: Package Optimization: Achieved a 23% reduction (15 KB) in the npm package size by identifying and excluding unnecessary files through updates to the .gitignore file
contributions_descriptions.4: New Feature: Implemented support for Salvadoran dishes in the randFood function, significantly expanding the range of example data available.
